title: Curated places
description: The hand-written places.yaml of a site: every destination a user can search for or be directed to. Each place takes its position from an OpenStreetMap element, a hand-placed location, or a hand-placed entrance, in that order of preference.

position.description: Longitude then latitude, as GeoJSON orders them.

id.description: Stable identifier used in share URLs; unique within the site.

number.description: The number the site's own signage and map use, if any.

category.description: One word the app groups and filters by, for example building or plaza.

annotation.description: A short note shown beside the name, such as the services inside.

keywords.description: Plain words a visitor might search for that are not in the name.

osm.description: OpenStreetMap element whose geometry places this feature, for example way/123.

location.description: Hand-placed position, used when no OpenStreetMap element fits.

entrance.description: Hand-placed entrance, where directions end; overrides the derived position.

verified.description: True once the position and name have been checked on foot.
